item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mega Romance
  • 発売日: 2009-11-27
  • スコア: 6.37/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姉教師～快楽に揺れる相剋の想い～
  • 英語名: Ane Kyoushi Kairaku ni Yureru Soukoku no Omoi

あらすじ

Shuichi was sexually abused by his older sister, Ayaka, when he was a kid…. That bitter experience made him crooked…. One day, Ayaka starts working at his school. Since she is such a beautiful woman, she soon gets popular among the students and teachers. Shuichi thinks, “You ruined my life, but you are now acting as if you did nothing bad to me….” He finally decides to make her his sex slave…. At first, he wears a mask and forcibly has sex with her. And then, he gives her various orders…. Like this, she gradually gets addicted to her indecent life….
